On a dry track, the 2026 car laps Interlagos in 1:10.772 — 0.973s slower than the 1:09.799 benchmark. The simulation lands inside the predicted band of 1:10.357–1:13.690.

Top speed reaches 339 km/h, but minimum speed drops to 82 km/h on this anticlockwise 7-corner circuit. The car trades straight-line pace for cornering grip, which costs time relative to the reference lap.
